The FloPlast universal hopper efficiently collects and diverts rainwater from guttering systems into both 65mm square and 68mm round downpipes. This robust drainage component ensures effective stormwater management for property exteriors. An ideal solution for new build projects and existing property refurbishment, this black uPVC hopper offers a practical and easy to install connection point. Its design means no lubrication is required for fitting, ensuring a straightforward setup for plumbers and builders. With a good flow capacity of 1.14 litres per second and compatibility across major drainage brands like Polypipe, Hepworth, Osma, Hunter, Marley, Brett and Marshall Tufflex, it provides a reliable drainage solution.
